description: This file defines an 'Option' class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace, handling post-edit and post-delete actions for options by scheduling tasks related to products associated with the option ID.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class handling events after editing or deleting options to schedule product info tasks.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Handles the event after editing an option; schedules a task for each related product.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles the event after deleting an option; schedules a task for each related product.
